```csharp
(OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileFlow mainFlow) => {
    
    /*** creating IMobileScreen 'Home' ***/
    var home2 = mainFlow.CreateScreen("Home");
    var eSpace = mainFlow.GetESpace();
    var registered = eSpace.SystemRoles.OfType<OutSystems.Model.Logic.ISystemRole>().Named("Registered");
    home2.Roles.Add(registered);
    home2.Description = null; // default value
    home2.PageName = "home";
    home2.SetTitle("\"Home\"");
    home2.OnDestroy.Destination = null; // default value
    home2.OnReady.Destination = null; // default value
    home2.OnRender.Destination = null; // default value
    
    var onInitialize = home2.CreateScreenAction("OnInitialize");
    onInitialize.Description = null; // default value
    
    var startNode = onInitialize.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();
    
    var logVisit = onInitialize.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IExecuteServerActionNode>("LogVisit");
    var logVisit2 = eSpace.ServerActions.Named("LogVisit");
    logVisit.Action = logVisit2;
    logVisit.HorizontalPosition = 3200;
    logVisit.VerticalPosition = 3200;
    startNode.Target = logVisit;
    
    var endNode = onInitialize.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    logVisit.Target = endNode;
    home2.OnInitialize.Destination = onInitialize;
    
    var layoutMainInstance = home2.CreateWidget<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.Widgets.IMobileBlockInstanceWidget>();
    layoutMainInstance.CustomStyle = null; // default value
    var mOD_DEMO_Layouts = eSpace.References.Named("MOD_DEMO_Layouts");
    var demoLayouts = mOD_DEMO_Layouts.MobileFlows.Named("DemoLayouts");
    var layoutMain = demoLayouts.Nodes.OfType<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileBlockSignature>().Named("LayoutMain");
    layoutMainInstance.SourceBlock = layoutMain;
    var hasFixedHeader = layoutMain.InputParameters.Named("HasFixedHeader");
    layoutMainInstance.SetArgumentValue(hasFixedHeader, "True");
    
    var placeholderContentWidget = layoutMainInstance.PlaceholdersContent.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Placeholder?.Name == "MainContent");
    var headerInstance = placeholderContentWidget.CreateWidget<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.Widgets.IMobileBlockInstanceWidget>();
    headerInstance.CustomStyle = null; // default value
    var commonFlow = eSpace.MobileFlows.Named("Common");
    var header = commonFlow.Nodes.OfType<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileBlock>().Named("Header");
    headerInstance.SourceBlock = header;
    var bannerInstance = placeholderContentWidget.CreateWidget<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.Widgets.IMobileBlockInstanceWidget>();
    bannerInstance.CustomStyle = null; // default value
    var commonFlow = eSpace.MobileFlows.Named("Common");
    var banner = commonFlow.Nodes.OfType<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileBlock>().Named("Banner");
    bannerInstance.SourceBlock = banner;
}
```
